title: Comparison of Methods for Recording Post Operative Pain
official: Comparison of Methods for Recording Post Operative Pain: A Prospective Randomized Trial
summary: The purpose of the current study is to identify the optimal method of collection of pain intensity data. The study will compare three collection methods: a hand-written pain journal, a smartphone app, and a novel electronic pain recorder device. Patients will be randomly assigned to one of three methods and instructed to record their pain level as often as they like. The number of pain intensity recordings per day will then be compared across groups.

interventions.name: Given novel electronic pain recording device

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient over 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient cannot use a smartphone
* Patient cannot use his hands to write or press a button
* Patient has a nerve catheter (has no pain)
* Altered mental status
* Neuropathy causing loss of pain sensation
